title: Proximity to swing high or swing low
description: The close of the evaluated bar sits within proximity_atr_multiple of ATR of the most recent confirmed swing high or swing low, measured in price units. The side tested is controlled by level_side.
thesis: Prior swing extremes are where resting orders accumulate. Distance to such a level, scaled by prevailing volatility, is the measurable form of the location question that price-action traders answer by eye.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: Price of the most recent confirmed swing high, using swing_lookback bars either side of the pivot.
Price of the most recent confirmed swing low, using swing_lookback bars either side of the pivot.
Average true range over atr_period, used to scale the proximity tolerance to prevailing volatility.

parameters.name: proximity_atr_multiple
parameters.description: Maximum distance between the close and the tested swing level, as a multiple of ATR. This is the measurable replacement for the discretionary proximity phrase at PID.md line 115.

parameters.name: swing_lookback
parameters.description: Number of bars required either side of a pivot before it is treated as a confirmed swing point.

parameters.name: atr_period
parameters.description: Lookback of the average true range used to scale the proximity tolerance, in bars of the evaluated timeframe.

parameters.name: level_side
parameters.description: Which swing level to test: HIGH tests the swing high only, LOW tests the swing low only, EITHER tests both and reports whichever is within tolerance.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: SHORT when the close is within tolerance of swing.high, since the level is overhead supply; LONG when the close is within tolerance of swing.low. When level_side is EITHER and both levels are within tolerance, the level with the lesser absolute distance determines direction.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True when the close is within the declared tolerance of a tested swing level.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: SHORT at a swing high, LONG at a swing low.

fields.name: level_price
fields.description: Price of the swing level the match was measured against.

fields.name: distance_atr
fields.description: Absolute distance between the close and that level, divided by ATR.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Which level was tested, the tolerance in ATR multiples and the observed distance.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Close is 3.0 below swing.high with an ATR of 8.0, a distance of 0.375 ATR, inside the 0.5 tolerance.
Close is 2.0 above swing.low with an ATR of 8.0, a distance of 0.25 ATR, inside the 0.5 tolerance.
Close is 20.0 from the closer level with an ATR of 8.0, a distance of 2.5 ATR, outside the 0.5 tolerance.
Close sits within tolerance of swing.high, but level_side is LOW so the swing high is not tested.

provenance.source_reference: PID.md line 55 — proximity to swing high/low; quantifies the proximity example at PID.md line 115.
provenance.notes: Architect-set defaults. Distance is scaled by ATR rather than fixed in pips so the same specification transfers across volatility regimes without re-tuning. The 0.5 default carries no evidential support yet.
